title: hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer thresholds and stabilize regional failover ordering
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Context: during a recent incident we observed SLO enforcer oscillation under partial regional degradation which caused cascading load-shedding and noisy failovers. Root cause: the enforcer's backoff+ordering logic allowed rapid successive circuit-breaker tripping across regions when transient errors coincided with our smoothing window. This PR tightens thresholds, smooths ordering, and adds conservative backoff to the regional failover path to prevent thrashing.

Changes in this PR: consolidated enforcer threshold constants, add per-region cooldown timers, switch regional failover ordering from best-effort to priority-stable queueing, and add a short-term emergency override that prefers local region capacity when healthy. Includes tests and a stress scenario in perf-canary harness.

Checklist:
- [x] add unit tests for cooldown timers and ordering
- [x] add integration test in slo-enforcer e2e harness
- [x] verify no perf regression on canary
- [x] update observability to emit "slo_enforcer.cooldown_start" and "slo_enforcer.cooldown_end"
- [x] include rollback plan and feature flag gating

Testing: ran the slo-enforcer canary for 6 hours with synthetic error bursts; observed elimination of quick thrash events and a 42% reduction in cross-region failovers during bursts. Manual regression of request latency and p50/p95 tokens unchanged.

Rollout: gated behind feature flag slo_enforcer_v2_enabled; default off for Dedicated customers, enabled by default in prod for host tier after canary.

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Can you add a short jitter to the cooldown expiry to avoid synchronized recovery?
Aisha Patel: Added 50-250ms jitter to cooldown expiry and documented reasoning in comments.
Emily Chen: The ordering change looks good but please ensure it doesn't starve lower-priority regions during sustained partial outages.
Aisha Patel: Added a gentle priority decay after 5 minutes of sustained preference so lower-priority regions get a chance; included integration test to validate.
Liam O'Neill: CI flaked on one integration run, re-ran and it's green now. Approving once CI stable.
release_notes: Hotfix: prevent SLO enforcer thrashing under partial regional degradation by tightening thresholds, adding per-region cooldowns, and stabilizing regional failover ordering. Backoff and jitter added to avoid synchronized recovery.
rollback_plan: Disable feature flag slo_enforcer_v2_enabled and revert via revert PR if unexpected regressions observed. Ops runbook updated with commands to reduce enforcer aggressiveness.
notes_for_ops: Look for metrics slo_enforcer.cooldown_start/slo_enforcer.cooldown_end and slo_enforcer.failover_event. If cross-region failovers spike after rollout, toggle slo_enforcer_v2_enabled off and open SRE escalation.
